name: Oni Coach!! ~Shouri e no Ryoujoku~
original_name: 鬼コーチ!! ～勝利への凌辱～
source:
Onimaya Gomon has gathered 10 girls for his sport team. He demands absolute obedience on his training sessions. He is absolutely sure that virginity is a hindrance during the training and must be cast away as soon as possible.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-april-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
Onimaya Gomon為他的運動隊召集了10名女孩。他要求大家絕對服從他的訓練。他確信童貞是訓練過程中的障礙，必須儘快拋棄。

［來自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-april-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]］
